name: poster
description: Agency-poster grid in Alloy colours: brand-blue slides with a near-black edge vignette alternate with off-white slides. Huge Manrope ExtraBold caps set tight, one Instrument Serif italic script word as the accent, a giant tone-on-tone ghost word echoing down the slide, a thin calligraphic swoop line and a slim footer bar with the handle.
source: themes/poster/refs/ref-3.png + ref-4.png (agency social-media poster grids), translated into brand/brand.json and brand/design-rules.md, October 2026
best_for: short punchy carousels where each slide is a poster
grid-led profiles that alternate blue and light tiles

slide_fields: ghost: the big background word (cover, stat, any slide); empty = no ghost
badge: circular stamp text on any slide (best on cta)
fill: true turns a slide into a near-black poster (brand blue in the ink variant)
